what: Tapping a photo in the gallery raises a backdrop-color veil (.7) in .4s, and a 6px-border box grows from its previous size (a 300px square at first) to the screen-fitted photo size in .4s linear, descending from the top edge of the screen to the center, then the photo and the info row (caption · image n / N · close) turn on in .2s. Tapping the left or right half of the photo, or pressing ← or →, moves to the previous or next one (the box refits to the new size in .4s). With the veil, close button or Esc, the box disappears at once and only the veil lifts in .4s

options.dur: Duration (seconds) for the box to resize to its new size, default .4 — 0 means instant
options.fade: Time for the curtain to drop and lift (sec), default .4
options.show: Duration (s) for the photo and info lines to appear, default .2
options.border: Box border (px), default 6 — also change --fx-border in css
options.margin: Margin to leave when fitting to screen (px), default 40
options.width: Value used as the photo’s actual width (px), default 1600 — height is derived from the cell’s aspect ratio. If a section sets data-w and data-h, those are used
options.[data-fx-part=item]: A photo cell to enlarge on click — this node is cloned into the box. Caption order: data-caption → aria-label → data-label
options.--fx-veil·--fx-frame: Curtain and border color, default Skin background (--kf-bg)
options.fx:close·fx:prev·fx:next: Point at an element for Close · Prev · Next

note: The original is the WordPress plugin wp-jquery-lightbox (GPL), so no code was used, it was rewritten with the same order and values (overlayOpacity .7 · white veil · borderSize 6 · resizeSpeed 400 linear · fadeIn fast · marginSize 40 · first box 300px). The swing curve is jQuery’s .5 − cos(πp)/2 converted to cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1).

from.where: detail.html .dt-gallery — photo collection in the construction case detail (original wp-jquery-lightbox, rel=lightbox)
lookbook.html photo grid (original gallery openLightbox: when .lightbox.open it is display flex, backdrop rgba(30,26,24,.95), photo fits 92vw·88vh, opens instantly with no motion)
from.options: dur: 0; fade: 0; show: 0; veil: .95; border: 0; margin: 40
